subject: Acme POC: Integration plan and success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC - post-call recap and next steps

Thanks for taking the time today, John — good conversation. Per our call, summary and proposed next steps for the 2-week POC: 

Summary / success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 400ms for single-turn message generation at payload sizes typical for your CRM snippets (~512 tokens).
- Cost: token cost benchmarking vs your current vendor with our default quantization; goal is 20% cost reduction per 1k tokens.
- Accuracy: parity with current vendor on entity extraction tests (we will run the 40-case evaluation set you shared).
- Stability: no more than one service incident during the POC window that impacts availability > 5 minutes.

POC scope and evaluation plan:
- Week 1: Integration + smoke tests. Redwood SE (Neha) will help with SDK setup, auth, streaming, and tool calling. 
- Week 2: Run evaluation harness (your 40-case set + live sample), collect latency/cost/quality metrics, and iterate on model/quantization settings.

Integration plan (high-level):
- Auth: API key scoped to POC account.
- SDK: use our Node/Python SDK (see attached quickstart).
- API routes: /v1/generate (sync), /v1/stream (SSE streaming), /v1/embeddings.
- Tool calling: support via function-schema in request body; we can demo callouts to your lookup service.

Ownership and timeline:
- Redwood: Marissa (sales) + Neha (SE) — technical kickoff once we have access.
- Acme: John (product) + Sally (integration lead).
- Target kickoff: Mon, Mar 30. Full POC completion: Fri, Apr 10.

Attachments: redwood-poc-integration-plan.pdf (detailed steps), integration-checklist.xlsx (tickets & owners).

Please reply with any adjustments to success criteria or timeline and confirm the kickoff time window next week.

Thanks,
Marissa

On Sun, Mar 29, 2026 at 9:15 AM John Doe <john.doe@acme.com> wrote:
> Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 
> 
> 1) Success criteria: the list looks good. On latency, can you confirm whether the 95th percentile threshold assumes warm KV cache and batching? Our production patterns have a mix of cold and warm starts.

Thanks John — short answers inline below and Neha will follow up with the technical kickoff/demo.

1) Latency assumptions: the 95th < 400ms is based on warm KV cache and conservative batching (batch sizes tuned to maintain latency SLO). For cold-starts (first token after model load) we expect higher latencies; we will instrument and report cold vs warm percentiles separately in the evaluation dashboard.

2) Streaming + tool calling: supported. Implementation notes: 
- Streaming: we support Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket streaming from /v1/stream. The Node SDK exposes a streaming iterator that yields partial tokens and metadata.
- Tool calling: include a functions field in the request body with your enrichment schema. Redwood will emit a tools.required event mid-stream when a function match is detected; you can either provide a sync callback (our SDK supports registering a function handler) or instruct Redwood to format a HTTP callback to your enrichment endpoint.

Example API routes (minimal):
- POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate  
  body: {"model":"redwood-llama-13b","input":"...","max_tokens":256} 
- POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream  (SSE)
  body: {"model":"redwood-llama-13b","input":"...","stream":true,"functions":[{"name":"enrich","schema":{...}}]}
- POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings

SDK quickstart links: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk#quickstart (Node/Python)

Ownership & kickoff:
- Neha will run the technical kickoff and demo (covers auth, SDK quickstart, stream + function demo, and pre-built evaluation harness).
- Rishi will be the point for any commercial questions or contract exceptions.

Timeline reminder: kickoff Mon Mar 30 10am PT, POC target completion Apr 10. Neha — can you share the quickstart + a minimal streaming + function-schema example ahead of kickoff?

Best,
Marissa
